note: Set A is more accurate in binding dimensions to their specific components, whereas Set B contains several clear misinterpretations of the drawing. Set B incorrectly attributes the 7'-0 1/8" height to the MDF Gable (it belongs to the MWB02 laundry stack) and misidentifies the 5" dimension as backsplash height (it is countertop thickness). Set B also miscalculates the combined width of MWK04+MWK05 as the total island width. Set A has one potential over-assignment of width to MWK04 but is otherwise more faithful to the visual evidence.
